_comment: Advisories scripts/ci/audit.sh pnpm may ignore. Every entry needs id (CVE or GHSA), reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails the lane. Empty since 2026-10-02: maplibre-gl's GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579 no longer matches any advisory, and image-size's two advisories cleared once metro moved to 0.83.8 (through @expo/metro 55.1.2), which vendors its own image-size reader instead of depending on the package. Fixed versions are pinned through pnpm.overrides in the root package.json (CLAUDE.md §9).
